title: Zambia Seeks 12-Month Extension to IMF Deal Ahead of Elections
content: Zambia’s cabinet has cleared the way for the southern African nation to request a 12-month extension of its International Monetary Fund program, a move that will please creditors as it will help the country maintain tighter controls on spending ahead of elections in August next year.
